## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      9 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 15, 2026 - Jul 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _happy_jammie_, Jul 21, 2026, 1/5: "Why is it that suddenly Chinese messages talking about AI replies keep coming up? And also random malfunctions where the bot just replies ‘the the the the the the’ multiple times? Please fix this as it is using up gems I don’t want used up for glitches in the system."
            2. _Don’t forget the quarter!_, Jun 29, 2026, 2/5: "It is a nice app. No filter. Short and clear answers. Since today, my bot has started talking all sorts of weird things. About needing to write better paragraphs; before, it didn't have any problems. Talking to the bot is very frustrating now. Please, fix this bug. And now when a bot is lagging, I refresh the app. And when I open it again it says I have to log in. Over and over again. The whole app is loading. I try to continue my chat with my bot but nothing works. Nothing shows. I’ve switched wifi etc, nothing works. The chat itself says ‘chat not found’. Very annoying. Please fix this bug. 🙏"
            3. _blandanimelover27_, Jul 23, 2026, 3/5: "ever since I’ve updated this app the bots response just stops either halfway or doesn’t finish, and it always happens when I get a good response so that just sucks. I have to create a new response and when I do, even that sometimes doesn’t finish. Please fix this issue cause it’s so frustrating and this app is pretty good overall"
